# Wikipedia test fixtures

`2026_in_archosaur_paleontology.r1383165113.wikitext` is a **trimmed excerpt** of
revision 1383165113 (2026-11-01) of the English Wikipedia article
[2026 in archosaur paleontology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_in_archosaur_paleontology),
used only to test the parser.

- **Authors:** the Wikipedia contributors listed in the
  [page history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2026_in_archosaur_paleontology&action=history).
- **License:** [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
  This excerpt is distributed under the same license, not under the project's
  AGPL-3.0 / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licenses.
- **Changes:** only selected table rows (12) and research bullets (29) were kept;
  everything else was removed. The kept text is unmodified.

Rows were chosen to cover the tricky cases: cells on the same line as `|`,
named references reused with `<ref name=… />`, a country with subdivisions in
parentheses, rows without status, a plain-text country, and research bullets
without a DOI.
